skills.name: humanizer

skills.evidence: 53.6k stars (top writing skill on GitHub); in skillsmp humanizer results; copied by aitmpl/claude-code-templates and others

skills.name: writing-shape
skills.purpose: Turns a raw-material markdown file (notes, fragments, transcript) into an article paragraph by paragraph: settles reader prerequisites, offers 2-3 openings, then grows and appends each block with deliberate format choices.
skills.how_to_use: Manual invoke only (disable-model-invocation); pass a markdown file of raw material and an output path.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~406k installs and on the trending list (Sept/Oct 2026); 274k-star repo
skills.notes: Lives in the repo's 'in-progress' folder, so paths may move. Sibling 'writing-beats' (same folder) is a choose-your-own-adventure variant of the same exploit step.

skills.name: writing-fragments
skills.purpose: Explore phase of Matt Pocock's writing pipeline: interviews the author relentlessly and appends usable fragments to one markdown file, without imposing structure.
skills.how_to_use: Manual invoke; run before writing-shape / writing-beats. Asks once where to save the fragments file.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~405k installs, trending; 274k-star repo
skills.notes: In-progress folder; pair with writing-shape.
